integration.classification: Joint mechanical/temperature increment law, no verified independent physical-time creep mechanism
integration.independent_coordinate: A monotone path coordinate s may drive E=d(epsilon)/ds and theta=dT/ds; source dots do not alone require physical seconds
integration.homogeneity: Host thermal terms are homogeneous degree1 under jointly multiplying E and theta by positive c; fu depends on stage state/T, not c. Conditional on selected exact host; not a numerical constitutive proof.
integration.hold: E=0,theta=0 should have zero RHS for regular host; zero mechanical increment with theta!=0 is not a hold and can produce stress/volume change. Source does not establish creep at fixed T/stress.
integration.reversal: Split temperature extrema so heating/cooling gate max(theta,0) is unambiguous. Crossing e=e_T_star needs branch-aware integration; no arbitrary epsilon/upper cap.
integration.transactions: Every mixed-control trial must start from same committed parent, including T and unresolved anchors; internal accepted substeps update a local candidate only. Failed segment restores parent and accepted prefix. No hidden NC preload or history-max reset.
integration.ordering: At each stage evaluate T,N,lambda and exact host map, then both bounding void ratios, then fu and stress/e RHS from same snapshot. This is required proposal, not source-prescribed discrete algorithm.
integration.spin: M17 objective rate; first implementation can explicitly restrict zero spin. General rotations require stress-rate/spin transformation.
integration.tangent: Joint mechanical and thermal columns; constrained tangent must include T dependence, e correction and fu branches. gamma=.1 threshold not differentiable; source does not prescribe AD continuation.
integration.unspecified: No discrete scheme, substep tolerances, algorithmic tangent, rollback, anchor-update chronology or boundary zero-denominator continuation specified in inspected2017 paper.
